text:
sasha: Heads up — after the kernel security patch rolled to us-west2 gpu nodepool this morning, ~6 GPU nodes moved to NotReady and got NoSchedule tainted. Pods stuck Pending with "node(s) had taints that the pod didn't tolerate". anyone else seeing this?

kyle: I see 4 nodes in NotReady here. kubelet logs show device-plugin keep failing to init, then kubelet adds NoSchedule taint. suspect race after driver rebind. quick dump: 

```
$ kubectl get nodes -o wide | egrep 'gpu|NotReady'
gpus-az-usw2-07   NotReady   3d   v1.26.3   192.168.8.57   us-west2
gpus-az-usw2-08   NotReady   4h   v1.26.3   192.168.8.58   us-west2

$ kubectl describe node gpus-az-usw2-07 | egrep -A2 'Taints|Conditions'
Taints:             node.kubernetes.io/not-ready:NoSchedule
Conditions:
  Ready               False   KubeletNotReady   kubelet has no heartbeat

$ kubectl -n kube-system logs ds/nvidia-device-plugin-daemonset -l kubernetes.io/hostname=gpus-az-usw2-07 --tail=50
E0321 09:12:10.123 device_plugin.go:189] timeout waiting for nvidia-smi: exit status 1
E0321 09:12:10.124 device_plugin.go:210] plugin init failed, retrying...
```

vivian: That timeout line is suspicious. Did the kernel patch change modesetting or module params? ops-bot, do we have the driver upgrade job status?

ops-bot: [deployment-job] driver-reinstall-us-west2 completed with 0 failures at 2026-03-21T08:50:00Z. But 12 nodes were targeted; 2 rolled back.

ryan: I captured systemd + dmesg on one node before cordon: 

```
$ sudo journalctl -u nvidia-drm.service -n 40 --no-pager
Mar 21 08:49:59 kernel: nvidia: loading out-of-tree module taints kernel
Mar 21 08:50:02 kernel: nvidia: GPU at PCI:0000:65:00: Initialized
Mar 21 08:50:06 kernel: nvidia: failed to allocate 0x1000 bytes for DRM
Mar 21 08:50:07 device-plugin[1]: ERROR: nvidia-smi timed out
Mar 21 08:50:08 kubelet[1]: NodeStatus: NotReady -> reason KubeletNotReady
```

kyle: Looks like after driver install nvidia-smi is intermittently failing -> device plugin gives up and kubelet taints node. Cluster-autoscaler also observed these nodes as "unready" and tried to scale down other pools which made scheduling worse. CA logs: "scale down blocked: nodes with GPU taint present".

sasha: Can we hotfix so user workloads don't get evicted? thinking: remove NoSchedule taint temporarily and restart device-plugin, then drain only if drivers still fail. any objections?

vivian: +1 for targeted approach. Proposed steps: 1) on affected nodes `kubectl taint nodes <node> node.kubernetes.io/not-ready:NoSchedule-` 2) `kubectl rollout restart ds/nvidia-device-plugin-daemonset -n kube-system --field-selector spec.nodeName=<node>` (or restart pod) 3) watch `kubectl describe node` and `kubectl logs` for nvidia-smi errors.

ryan: Alternative quick patch: scale device-plugin ds to 0 then back to desired to force reinit across nodes. but that touches all AZs. If we only 1 nodepool affected, do per-node pod restart.

kyle: Did a manual taint-remove + pod-restart on gpus-az-usw2-07, device-plugin recovered, nvidia-smi started responding, node returned Ready after ~40s. Marking as tentative fix.

sasha: Nice. I'll run the same on the other 3 nodes. Also opening infra ticket to pin driver package that passed integration tests and prevent auto-rollout until we validate.

ops-bot: [incident] created: INC-2026-03121 (infra) — GPU driver rollout caused transient device-plugin failures, nodes tainted NoSchedule. P0 -> P1.

vivian: Follow-ups: 1) add a pre-check in the driver rollout job to run `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=name --format=csv` and retry on transient errors 2) make the device-plugin more tolerant to a couple of nvidia-smi timeouts before kubelet tainting the node 3) add CA annotation to ignore nodes for scale-down during rollouts 4) run a canary pool in us-west2 for next driver release.

sasha: I'll take 1 and 3. Kyle can you pick up 2 (device-plugin retry policy) and Ryan take canary plan?

kyle: Yep. I'll open PR for plugin backoff and mention this thread.

ryan: Canary plan in a doc link: https://redwood.internal/ops/driver-canary-us-west2 (will share runbook).

sasha: Thanks team. rolling fixes now, will update when all 6 nodes green. :thumbsup:
